description: Implementation class for managing static content files, providing methods to add, remove, and retrieve files via underlying FilePut, FileGet, and FileRemove components.

classes.name: StaticContentFileManagerImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of static content file management, handling file operations such as add, get, and remove.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single static content file for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file based on content type and filename.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of filenames for a static content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a merchant store.
